fixes.target: figure-p2: What you need to know as a busy builder
fixes.value: Photo panel of four numbered steps, each with a red cross photo (wrong way) and a green tick photo (right way): 1. Plan your work – remove or protect soft furnishings and surfaces with plastic sheeting, wear disposable overalls and an FFP3 mask; 2. Stop dust getting into the air – use wet abrasive paper or on-tool extraction, passive capture bags on tools are less effective; 3. Stop lead fume being produced – set hot air guns or infrared equipment below 500° C, do not use gas torches or blow lamps. Step 4 is: Wash hands and forearms before eating, drinking and smoking – the small sink is not suitable, provide a large sink, hot or warm running water, soap and towels. The photos show a person sanding indoors versus a person in a white suit, a sander without and with extraction, a gas blow lamp versus a hot air gun, and hands in a small sink versus a forearm in a large sink, with the Working Well Together logo and an HSE guidance note below.
fixes.reason: Described the four-step photo panel with printed text from the image, in three sentences.
fixes.evidence: Image shows steps 1 to 4 with red cross and green tick photos, printed text as quoted, and the footer with the Working Well Together logo.
